name: Hudson Street
description: Hudson Street, known as 'the Hudson's', was a Chicago street gang active in the early-to-mid 1960s in the neighborhood north of the Cabrini Green housing projects. It was one of three founding gangs — alongside Mohawk Street (the Mohawks) and the Cleveland Jammers — that merged to form The CORP, a prominent white gang whose turf ran along North Avenue in the Lincoln Park/Old Town area of Chicago.
